page.overview:
Who is Hiroshi Sato?

By 174 AG, Hiroshi grew remorseful over his actions and tried to reconcile with his daughter, Asami. When Kuvira threatened Republic City, Hiroshi was momentarily released from prison by Lin Beifong and helped to equip the prototypes of the hummingbird mecha suits with plasma saws. He ultimately sacrificed his life to give Team Avatar the opportunity to take down the Colossus and its spirit energy cannon by cutting through its platinum armor and giving them an entry.

Hiroshi Sato was born in 120 AG to a poor family from the Dragon Flats borough. Before long, he was producing Satomobiles in his first "Future Industries" factory. By the time he was twenty-five, the ingenious industrialist had made his first million yuans.

He eventually met Yasuko, a successful architect. The two of them fell in love and married, and had a daughter named Asami together in 152 AG. However, six years later, Yasuko was killed by a member of the Agni Kai Triad after they broke in and robbed the Sato estate. This led to Hiroshi's extreme hatred of all benders and convinced him to join Amon's Equalists in secret.

In 166 AG, Hiroshi met with Wonyong Keum, wanting the latter's help in developing gas dispersing pumps for the Equalists. Keum however refused to do so, earning himself the enmity of the Sato family, with Asami assuming that Keum had simply walked out on an important deal with Hiroshi.
